records.text: In a clip played by Owens, Zacharia said she read The Real Anthony Fauci cover to cover and used what she described as known facts to make a case for not taking anything Fauci recommended.
records.speaker: Katie Zacharia

appearances.snippet: He wrote a book called The Real Anthony Fauci, which I read cover to cover to substantiate all of the theories that were actually not, not theories, the known facts about him, and was able to make a case because that's what we do as lawyers, for the reason why I would not take anything Fauci (Anthony Fauci) recommended.
